asr.full_text: So the middle of today, the market actually started to bounce back a little bit. I was looking like we could pick up a little bit of momentum to run into the later part of the day. But then we actually had something that just gave us a little bit of a curveball at the end of the week. What is this now going to look like? We're going to talk about that in this video. I do also want to talk about something that is pretty wild for ADA we do not typically see this taking place and there was actually this really good illustration of why Cardano has such a huge opportunity for the future when it comes to adoption so if you're new or haven't already show your support for the channel down below make sure you hit that subscribe button that bell it's free to do it'll keep you updated anytime there's new content live here on the channel so we we have actually, around mid-day, gotten down to about 24 1⁄2 cents for ADA. This was with BTC actually dropping down to about 74, 750. And we actually saw BTC kind of bouncing back as well. We were getting a nice little bounce here in the early part of the afternoon, but then we got a little bit of a curve ball and this caused the market to continue to drop, and again, now there are big questions about, will this get worse headed into the week, and we'll discuss that more in just a moment, but I have to say that right now, shorts are betting very heavily, they're betting for downside, they're betting for oil to surge, headed into the week, ADA right now actually has a 20% imbalance to the short side, just to give you some context of what leverage is doing. Just as we obviously went on a rally to the upside, they're betting that the markets are going to crater and move the opposite direction. They might be right. Who knows? Nobody knows what the future is going to look like. We obviously hope that we're going to follow that, what's it called, formula. We've been following week after week after week. We hope we're going to get a bounce in the early part of the week when we're getting news like this. It doesn't really paint that great of a picture. First of all, Iran says no negotiating team is being sent to Pakistan yet due to the U S blockade. It sounds like JD Vance is going to be flying into Pakistan tomorrow for these potential potential negotiations but it sounds like iran is not coming to the table yet and the us now is playing uh definitely some hard ball in trying to get iran to cooperate in fact this was the news this afternoon that caused more of this red that we're seeing in the later part of the afternoon so uh president trump actually announced that today an iranian cargo ship named tuska nearly three nearly 900 feet long and weighing almost as much as an aircraft carrier tried to get past the naval blockade and it did not go well for them the u.s navy guided missile destroyer uss uh spruance intercepted the telska in the gulf of omen and gave them a fair warning to stop the iranian crew refused to listen so the navy ship stopped them right there in their tracks blowing a hole in their engine room right now the u.s marines have custody of the vessel the tauska is under u.s treasury sanctions because of their prior history of illegal activity we have full custody of the ship and we are seeing what's on board so this is obviously a clear um i i get i don't want to say necessarily a breach of ceasefire because obviously the the U.S. has said that Iran has breached the ceasefire, but it's a clear escalation, right? And things may get worse headed into the early part of the week, especially if Iran decides to retaliate or can retaliate. Obviously, there hasn't really been a whole lot of news of Iran doing much as of late, and obviously that could change nobody knows what the future is going to bring but this obviously is the U.S. playing a hardball and the markets aren't necessarily going to like that we're already seeing that right because this is again a step in the wrong direction it had been pretty peaceful pretty quiet a lot of back and forth going on but this is a clear clear step that might not bode well for the markets come the early part of the week so that is something I wanted to make sure everybody was aware of i'm sure people were you know wondering why we did get this drop in the later half of the afternoon it's been a pretty still quiet day for the most part um volume for example is slightly slightly rising after being 111 billion dollars we've climbed almost to 120 billion dollars so again i am expecting a lot of volatility here in the week that could mean up down left right sideways you know who knows what's going to take place but i did want to mention this and there was actually a great question from a viewer as to why i remain so optimistic and here's the thing is i'm i don't even want to say i'm a sheer just you know all-time optimist i'm very level-headed in my approach to this okay i believe that crypto long term is going to get adopted i believe blockchain tech is going to get adopted long her long term and i understand that right now we're not in the best of times there are a lot of things that are creating massive uncertainty for the market that times could get worse. That prices could get lower. But the thing is, is that doesn't change the direction of crypto long-term, right? This is one of those times where you look back and they were kind of a blip in the radar, right? China, you know, basically banning crypto in 2021. It's kind of a blip on the radar. The COVID crash in 2020, it's a blip on the radar. And you could go back throughout crypto history and see many times that people said it was dead and no progress was gonna be made. And they didn't end up meaning anything in the long run. And I think that that is where we're headed towards. And again, we're starting to see some signs of big adoption, institutional interest, enterprises and governments, building with blockchain tech, and I thought this was a really good illustration, and this was comparing with Ethereum, Solana, and Cardano, and it really talked about the different exploits and incidents that have occurred on change with each of these different blockchains. And it shows you how there is a distinct difference between you Cardano and these other blockchains in the space. This is exactly what Cardano was built for. It's built for security. It's built for perfect uptime. It's built for the big adoption that it's gonna be coming to the space. That is why I remain confident. That is why I remain optimistic about what the future's going to be coming to the space that is why i remain confident that is why i remain optimistic about what the future is going to look like right now you know again like i said prices could get lower we could see more downside you could see more negativity in the markets but again we think long term we think adoption we think big use this doesn't change any of that so that that's something i at least wanted to just briefly mention. Appreciate Curdopia for taking the time to put this together. But we'll obviously see where we are in the early part of the week. I hope that things obviously do not escalate. But you know, these weekends tend to bring us curveball after curveball after curveball. And I'm sure that you guys are as tired of it as I am, but you know, all we can do at this point is just kind of roll with the punches. So I appreciate you have a great day enjoy the rest of your weekend catch you guys tomorrow take care
